description:
MySQL connection manager with SSH tunnel support.

MySQL connection manager with SSH tunnel support, encrypted password storage, automatic output masking for AI and non-TTY environments, native MySQL driver support, and export formats including markdown, CSV, JSON, and PDF.
0.11.0 (2026-11-02)
Features
- export に --with-queries を追加し保存クエリを同梱する (#143) (2faa592)
Dependencies
- Update Go dependencies (golang.org/x/crypto, golang.org/x/term, and golang.org/x/sys) (#205).
- Update @remotion/cli to 4.0.482, retain the latest main-branch demo dependencies, and update transitive fast-uri to 3.1.9 to address dependency-review findings (#140).
